rawSiteProfile.name: Budget Shooter Supply
rawSiteProfile.notes: Reloading-focused WooCommerce (Woodmart theme). API-only crawl - HTML grid is AJAX-loaded and unreliable. Global API crawl (no category filter - WP REST product_cat doesn't recurse). 209 categories total, deeply nested. /shop/ returns 404, use /products/ as shop page.

verifyBehavior.notes: Store API may not return all products due to pagination limits, caching, or visibility filters. Only Playwright detail-page visit can confirm deletion (HTTP 404).

steps.notes: Primary discovery. 2756 products, 100/page, 28 pages. Supports orderby=date, modified_after/before filters.
Enrichment. 1598 in-stock products. Prices in cents (divide by 100).

rawSiteProfile.perPageNote: API uses per_page=100 (WP REST max). HTML shop page is Woodmart AJAX-loaded, shows ~24 but unreliable for crawling.
rawSiteProfile.shopPageNote: /shop/ returns 404. WooCommerce shop page is configured as /products/
rawSiteProfile.htmlCrawlNote: Woodmart theme with AJAX shop (woodmart-ajax-shop-on). Static HTML only shows sidebar widget products (5 in <main>). Full product grid requires JS execution. API is the only reliable crawl path.
rawSiteProfile.catalogUrlsNote: Single global shop page. WP REST API product_cat filter does NOT recurse into children (parent cats return 0), so per-category API crawl is not viable. Global API crawl via /wp-json/wp/v2/product is the only reliable path. The /products/ URL is for HTML fallback reference only.
rawSiteProfile.wafProbeEvidence: server: Apache on all responses. No cf-ray, x-sucuri, or vendor headers. SQLi/XSS probes get 403 from Apache mod_security (not a WAF proxy). All UAs return 200. Rapid burst 10x no throttle.

paginationPattern.note: WP REST API pagination via ?page=N param. HTML uses /page/N/ but AJAX grid makes it unreliable.

productCountMethod.storeApiNote: Store API returns in-stock only (1598 vs WP REST 2756 all published)

rawSiteProfile.sortVerifiedEvidence: WP REST API ?orderby=date&order=desc returns IDs descending: page1 first=96950, last=94751; page2 first=94725. Monotonic. HTML sort not applicable (Woodmart AJAX grid).
